crossRefs.note: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.
If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and…
‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
